in_marathi.name: Gyanendra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gyanendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gyanendra is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Gyan’ meaning knowledge and ‘Indra’ meaning sovereign or king. Gyanendra is a name that signifies wisdom and power, a wise ruler who governs with knowledge and understanding.
